pages.text: A woman with snakes for hair, in a ruined temple on the coast. Her bite poisons.
Abilities: her gaze slows you, and after 3 seconds it starts to turn you to stone. Protection: a shield in hand, a carved pumpkin on your head, or simply do not look at her.
How to beat: the harpe of Perseus hurts her twice as much. Drops the head of Medusa: right-click it to turn everything in front of you to stone.
